$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-toggle-group) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Figma's root wraps an items frame that carries the gap; in code the group lays its items out itself (see items). A joined Outline group draws its border as an inset shadow on ::after, above the items. Width is skipped: a horizontal group is the sum of its hugging labels (see the manifest).

items.$why: The items frame is the group itself in code: same size, padding and gap.

Toggle.$why: Items hug their label (width follows glyph rasterisation; the size check covers the group).

Toggle#1.$why: As Toggle; in a joined Outline group the divider is a 1 px inset shadow on the leading side.
